subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving completed bookings for {Brand}, the metasearch journey from fare comparison through to a ticketed reservation. The one point worth repeating: we optimise MAFO to the completed booking and read it back through your booking confirmation, held through the cancellation window so cancellations inside it are not billed. At scale that holds an eCPA on the booking of 9 pounds, the volume you settle being bookings that ticketed. If it helps, I can pull the route-level booking read for your UK funnel. Open to a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate completed-booking validation proof
illustrative_flags: eCPA on the booking of 9 pounds (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN travel_and_booking flights aggregator: references prior outreach in S1; restates single proof (MAFO optimised to completed booking + booking-confirmation read + cancellation-window hold); one illustrative figure (eCPA 9 pounds), flagged; British spelling (optimise/pounds); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y' (stated positively).
